The objective of this Study Guide to accompany James and Ashwill: Nursing Care of Children: Principles and Practice, fourth edition, is to facilitate your understanding of the material presented in the textbook.

Each chapter in this Study Guide is meant to be used as a studying tool for its corresponding textbook chapter. Chapters are presented in the same numerical order as in the textbook. At the end of this manual, you will find answers to the Student Learning Exercises and Review Questions for all Study Guide chapters.
Each chapter includes the following features, which are designed to help you better comprehend and organize the textbook material.
1.  Helpful Hints refer you to other chapters in the core textbook or to other references for background information that may enhance your understanding of the chapter.
